Through its Persian origins, the name embodies the importance of unfathomable riches of spiritual knowledge and uplifting wisdom in the Islamic tradition. The name evokes the idea that the most valuable treasures lie not in worldly possessions but in the wisdom and guidance that abound in spirituality, a reminder to place intrinsic value upon spiritual growth and personal development.
